occupations.cat: Hospitality, retail and other services managers

n.story:
Your role is evolving from a crisis-manager to a strategic 'experience architect.' AI will take over the heavy lifting of back-office operations—automatically ordering supplies based on predictive demand, optimizing staff schedules, and even handling the first tier of customer complaints. This massive reduction in administrative friction allows you to step out of the office and onto the floor, focusing on staff mentorship, brand storytelling, and high-stakes event coordination.

You will use AI as a powerful decision-support engine to maximize revenue and minimize waste. Instead of guessing which promotions might work, you'll launch data-backed campaigns that AI has already simulated for success. Your day will shift from 'monitoring' to 'innovating,' using real-time analytics to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability standards are not just met, but exceeded. You become the human heart of a highly efficient, tech-enabled ecosystem.
